description: Convert AI Settings Modal to a dedicated /settings page, make the entire interface responsive with proper mobile/tablet/desktop breakpoints, and improve overall styling with better spacing, transitions, and visual hierarchy.
steps: Create src/app/settings/page.tsx - A dedicated settings page with the same functionality as the modal but as a full page with a back button/link to return home
Modify src/app/page.tsx - Replace modal state and import with a Link to /settings, make layout responsive with mobile/tablet/desktop breakpoints
Modify src/components/FaceDetector.tsx - Make video responsive (full width on mobile, 2/3 on desktop), responsive detection panel grid
Modify src/app/dashboard/page.tsx - Responsive header navigation and grid/chart sizing
Improve src/app/globals.css with better global styles, transitions, and animations
acceptance_criteria: Settings gear icon navigates to /settings page instead of opening a modal
The /settings page has full AI configuration functionality (base URL, API key, model name, validate, save)
The /settings page has a back button/link to return to the home page
The interface is responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop
FaceDetector video is full width on mobile and 2/3 on desktop
Dashboard has responsive grid and chart sizing
Build passes with npm run build
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it completes successfully with exit code 0
